items.name: Picanha Steak Sandwich
items.description: Our Steakhouse Classic sandwich features succulent picanha, caramelized onions, tangy tomato, and creamy provolone cheese, all topped with a savory roasted garlic aioli, served on a warm baguette. This sandwich is perfect for anyone who loves classic steakhouse flavors with a Brazilian twist.

items.name: The Dipper
items.description: The Dipper sandwich is a delicious meal that's perfect for dipping and diving into rich and savory flavors. The tender and juicy short rib is perfectly paired with gooey Swiss cheese, caramelized onions, and a generous serving of beef au jus, creating a symphony of flavors and textures that will keep your taste buds satisfied.

items.name: Flank Steak Sandwich
items.description: The Flank-a-Vocado sandwich is a mouthwatering treat that combines the rich, tender flavor of flank steak with the creamy texture of avocado. The juicy tomato and roasted garlic aioli add a burst of tangy and savory flavors to this already irresistible sandwich. With every bite, you'll experience a delicious explosion of flavors that will leave you craving for more.

items.name: The BBQ Rib Sandwich
items.description: This barbeque sandwich is a flavor-packed meal! A tender and juicy short rib with smoky BBQ sauce, and tangy apple slaw, all nestled in a warm baguette. A Brazilian touch with its bold and zesty flavors, inspired by the vibrant culture of Rio de Janeiro.

items.name: Chicken Pesto Brasileiro
items.description: Our Pesto Brasileiro sandwich is a delicious twist on a classic sandwich. Grilled chicken is paired with creamy provolone cheese, tangy roasted peppers, and sautéed mushrooms, all topped with a generous serving of home made basil pesto, creating a unique and flavorful sandwich that's perfect for anyone who loves bold and exotic flavors.

items.name: Picanha Bowl
items.description: This Picanha Bowl is a perfectly balanced meal that has a delicious combination of juicy Picanha, hearty Fejuada, fluffy Brazilian rice, crispy Farofa, and sweet banana, bringing together a flavorful bowl.

items.name: Rio Grande Bowl
items.description: Immerse yourself in the bold and authentic flavors of Brazil with our Rio Grande Bowl. Feast on juicy grilled chicken breast, savory sausage, hearty Fejuada, fluffy Brazilian rice, crunchy Farofa, and sweet banana, all mixed together to create a feast for the senses.

items.name: Grilled Shrimp Bowl
items.description: The Grilled Shrimp Bowl is a satisfying and flavorful meal consisting of succulent grilled shrimp, fluffy Brazilian rice, hearty black beans, zesty grilled lime, and fragrant coriander.  This bowl offers a delightful combination of tastes in every bite.

items.name: Sicilian Brioche
items.description:
The brioche, plain or filled with ice cream or Nutella, is perfect for your snack!
The origins of the brioscia cu’ tuppo go way back in Sicilian pastry tradition - one of the richest in all of Italian cuisine! Tuppo means “Chignon” in Sicilian, it resembles the classic low chignon hairstyle.
Whether for breakfast or a snack, brioche with gelato is a true Sicilian ritual. The perfect combo? Slightly warming up the brioche before filling it with gelato!

items.name: Egg Omelette
items.description:
Start your day right with our classic egg omelet, a versatile and delicious dish perfect for breakfast, brunch or any time you crave something quick and satisfying. Our omelet is made with farm-fresh eggs, beaten to perfection and cooked until fluffy and golden. It is seasoned with a hint of salt and pepper and filled with fresh vegetables, cheese and herbs.
Each bite of our egg omelet offers a delightful combination of textures and flavors, with the creamy eggs complementing the savory fillings. It's a wholesome and nutritious option that can be customized to suit your taste preferences.

items.name: Qeema (Minced Meat Curry)
items.description:
Savor the rich and hearty flavors of Qeema, a classic minced meat curry that embodies the essence of traditional cuisine. This flavorful dish features finely minced meat, slow-cooked with a blend of aromatic spices, tomatoes, and onions, resulting in a mouthwatering and satisfying meal.

Our Qeema is prepared with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every bite is infused with the perfect balance of spices and herbs. The minced meat is tender and juicy, absorbing the robust flavors of the curry, making it an ideal choice for any occasion.

items.name: Egg Half Fry
items.description:
Enjoy the simplicity and deliciousness of our egg half fry, a perfect addition to any meal. This classic dish features a farm-fresh egg, fried to perfection with a crispy edge and a soft, runny yolk at the center. Lightly seasoned with a touch of salt and pepper, our egg half fry is both flavorful and satisfying.
Ideal for breakfast, brunch, or even as a quick snack, the egg half fry is versatile and can be paired with a variety of dishes. Whether you enjoy it with toast, paratha, or as a topping on your favorite salad or bowl, it adds a delightful burst of protein and flavor.

items.name: Maghaz Egg Fry
items.description:
Delight in the exotic flavors of maghaz brain masala, a luxurious and richly spiced dish that is a true testament to culinary tradition. this delicacy features tender and creamy lamb brain, skillfully cooked with a harmonious blend of aromatic spices, onions, tomatoes, and fresh herbs, creating a sumptuous and unforgettable experience.
our maghaz is a perfect balance of flavor and texture, with the delicate brain absorbing the robust spices, resulting in a dish that is both indulgent and satisfying. each bite promises a melt-in-your-mouth sensation, enhanced by the warming spices and fragrant herbs.

items.name: Karak Tea
items.description: Experience the rich and soothing flavors of karak tea, a beloved traditional beverage that offers warmth and comfort in every sip. this aromatic tea is prepared by brewing strong black tea with a blend of spices, including cardamom and cinnamon, and simmering it with creamy milk to create a perfectly balanced and flavorful drink. our karak tea is carefully crafted to achieve the ideal blend of sweetness, spice, and creaminess, making it a perfect companion for any time of the day. whether you enjoy it with breakfast, as an afternoon pick-me-up, or as a relaxing evening treat, karak tea is sure to delight your senses.

items.name: Chicken Stew
items.description:
A mild and creamy Kerala delicacy made with tender chicken, potatoes, onions, green chilies,
ginger, and whole spices, gently simmered in thick coconut milk. Lightly spiced and full of
comforting flavor — best enjoyed with appam or idiyappam.

items.name: Nadan Kozhi Curry
items.description:
A traditional country-style chicken curry prepared with roasted coconut, shallots, curry leaves,
and bold Kerala spices. Rich, robust, and packed with authentic homely taste.

items.name: Aleppy Chicken Curry
items.description:
A classic Mappas-style curry from the heart of Alappuzha, featuring juicy chicken cooked in a
mildly spiced coconut milk gravy with onions and tomatoes. Creamy, aromatic, and perfect with
soft pathiri or appam.

items.name: Kanthari Chicken Curry
items.description:
A fiery chicken curry infused with the heat of kanthari mulaku (bird’s eye chili), coconut milk,
and minimal spices. Bold and spicy with a natural kick — a favorite for heat lovers.

items.name: Chicken Chittulli
items.description:
A semi-dry, spicy chicken dish made with shallots, garlic, curry leaves, and crushed red chilies.
Smoky, rustic, and full of traditional Kerala flavors — perfect as a side or starter.

items.name: Kozhi Kurumulak Curry
items.description:
A bold and peppery chicken curry made with freshly crushed black pepper, onions, and curry
leaves in a thick, spicy gravy. A hearty and warming dish with the signature taste of Kerala
spices.

items.name: Kozhi Porichath
items.description:
Deep-fried chicken marinated in a flavorful blend of local spices, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves,
then fried to crispy perfection. Served as 8 pieces — crunchy on the outside, juicy on the inside.
A timeless Kerala favorite.

items.name: Butter Chicken Masala
items.description:
A North Indian-inspired classic with grilled chicken tikka simmered in a rich, buttery, and tangy
tomato-based sauce. Mildly sweet, creamy, and irresistibly smooth — a dish loved by both kids
and adults.

items.name: Koonthal Dry Fry
items.description: Crispy fried squid coated in aromatic Kerala spices. This dry fry is packed with flavour and crunch, making it a must-try for seafood lovers in Dubai.

items.name: Koonthal Ulathiyath
items.description: A classic Kerala-style dry roasted squid dish, tossed with onions, coconut bits, and pepper. Rich in spice and texture, perfect with Malabar parotta.

items.name: Tawa Grilled Prawns
items.description: Tender prawns marinated in spicy Kerala masala and grilled on a flat tawa. Smoky, juicy, and a perfect choice for seafood grill fans – 12 pieces per portion.

items.name: Pall Konju
items.description: Prawns simmered in creamy coconut milk gravy with mild spices – rich and comforting. Goes best with appam, nool parotta, or Kerala rice.

items.description: Boldly spiced kingfish cooked in thick roasted masala, slow-cooked to absorb every flavour. A favourite among Malabar seafood dishes.

items.name: Harsha
items.description:
Traditional semolina bread or griddle cake. It is made primarily from semolina, butter, milk (or water), and a bit of salt and sugar. The dough is shaped into small, flat discs and then cooked on a griddle or in a pan until golden brown.
Harsha has a crumbly texture and is often served for breakfast or as a snack. It can be enjoyed plain, with honey, butter, cheese, or jam. It's a popular and versatile item in Moroccan cuisine, appreciated for its simplicity and delightful taste

items.name: Tkalya
items.description: Traditional dish made from offal, specifically tripe and other organ meats. The dish is often prepared with a variety of spices, including cumin, paprika, garlic, and cilantro, and is slow-cooked to create a flavorful and hearty stew. Tkalya is typically served with bread and is enjoyed for its rich and robust flavors. It is a popular dish during special occasions and is part of Morocco's diverse culinary heritage.
